The other two branches are correct: line 19 returns text unchanged when already within max, and line 20 handles max <= ellipsis.length by returning ellipsis.slice(0, max) (matching the expected truncate('abcdef', 2) === '..').

Per the docstring and README, the total length must never exceed `max`.
